comments.author: Kossmynn
comments.body: Very important; the "Sarcophagus" discovery card from the Hidden Passage in Middle Rome Dungeon is DIFFERENT from the "Sarcophagus" card given my the map from Archives! ! ! The card from Rome has 4 diamonds, while the card from the map has only 1!

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
You may enter this dungeon at any time via the Church in Rome. The enemies within are extremely high level, however. It consists of two floors:

Upper Floor (available at the start)
Middle Floor (requires Sarcophagus discovery which Kossmynn describes in the comment above -- all fleet members must have the discovery or Middle Floor remains inaccessible)

comments.author: Kurama
comments.body:
Seems the secret passages % rate are related with the speed/ how many devices you activate in the room, right?

I tryed to activate all devices and as fast as possible and eventually i felt in a room full of "Soul of Coliseum" enemyes. They glowed purple.

Hard fight.

Loot was junk, just trade goods.

The best loot i found there, in Rome church dungeon, are the +2 art robes. Nice for adventure alts. But they are in a room without any enemy and you have to unlock all the devices there without failure.

Oh, the sparkling and splendid chests are a plus too. The easy acess and the challenging battles make this dungeon a more enjoyable farming of these chests than Siberia, imo.

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Roman Church Dungeon - Upper Level
Rank: 1*
Ruin Exploration Rate Increase: +1 Point(s)
Expedition Ship Boarding Ticket Cost: x1 per run
Number of Floors: 2
Discovery: The Catacombs of Rome
Hidden Room Discovery: Buried Glassware (required to access Dungeon's Middle Level; all current fleetmembers *must* have this discovery or Middle Level cannot be accessed)
Level of Enemy NPCs: 72
Treasure:

1F (4 chests): Marble Sculptures, Ceramics, Antique Art, Jewellery, Bronze Sculptures, Stone Sculptures, Glasswork
2F (3 chests): Headache Medicine, Fine Velvet, Oil Paintings, Antique Art, Velvet, Silverwork, Silverware
Hidden Room: Silver Tarot, Purchase Order (Category 3), Purchase Order (Category 4), Clay, Shipwreck Map Piece, Fine Velvet, Exquisite Velvet, Fine Fur, Fine Dye, Single-handed Swords, Crystal, Clavi Toga

Roman Church Dungeon - Middle Level
Rank: 1*
Ruin Exploration Rate Increase: +2 Point(s)
Expedition Ship Boarding Ticket Cost: x1 per run
Number of Floors: 3
Discovery: Ancient Amphora
Hidden Room Discovery: Sarcophagus
Level of Enemy NPCs: 72, 75, 80 (Hidden Room)
Treasure:

3F (4 chests): Glasswork, Antique Art, Bronze Sculpture, Embroidery Thread, Goldwork, Oil Painting, Stone
4F (4 chests): Glasswork, Gold, Silver, Gold Thread, Clay, Goldwork, Oil Paintings, Luxury Velvet
5F (3 chests): Platinum, Peridot, Diamond, Jewellery, Asclepius' Medicated Bath, Exquisite Velvet, Explorer's Household Medicine, Shipwreck Map Piece
Hidden room: Oil painting, Peridot, Silverware, Antique Art, Marble Sculpture, Silver Tarot, Spikenard Oil (no-trade), Clavi Toga
Hidden room (strong armed gladiator Lv75 etc.): Spikenard Oil (no-trade), Manual of Surprise Hit v5, Manual of Traps v5, Infiorata Recollections, Silver Tarot
Hidden Room (Gladiator Spirit Lv80 x10): Pegasus Feather, Silver Tarot, Shipwreck Map Piece
Boss Drop: Thracian Helmet

I'm afraid this isn't quite as comprehensive as my usual work; my apologies, but of all the UWO dungeons, this is one which I've spent the least amount of time in so I am relying more on other sources rather than personal experience for some of the item/trade good drops. All data was compiled from the following sources:

www.ssjoy.org/dho/dungeon/62014
www.ssjoy.org/dho/dungeon/62085
gvo.gamedb.info/wiki/?Dungeon%2F%A5%ED%A1%BC%A5%DE%C3%CF%B2%BC%B0%E4%C0%D7

Feel free to double-check for yourselves. Cheers, and great underground ruin raiding to you.
